findings.current: The shame and despair gripping him were unlike anything he had ever felt before.
findings.defect: The source describes shame and despair enveloping his entire body. “Gripping him” drops both the full-body image and its explicit scope, which the accepted baseline preserved.
findings.rationale: 전신을 감싼 means “wrapping around his entire body”; the source emphasizes the emotions surrounding him physically, not simply gripping him.
findings.replacement: The shame and despair wrapping around his entire body were unlike anything he had ever felt before.

summary: The assembled translation is faithful overall, with one minor loss of a source-specific image.
